title: relsynth IR 2.0
description: A data estate: everything relsynth reads, models and writes.

name.description: Label used in reports and file names.

kind.description: csv / parquet / files: one <table>.csv, .csv.gz or .parquet file per table in `path`; sqlite: `path` to a file; postgresql, mssql, oracle, mysql, mariadb, databricks, fabric, snowflake, bigquery (or sqlalchemy for any other engine): `url`.

path.description: Folder (files) or file (sqlite); relative to the spec's folder.

url.description: Database URL, e.g. postgresql://user@host/db, mssql+pyodbc://user@host/db?driver=ODBC+Driver+18+for+SQL+Server, oracle://user@host:1521/?service_name=ORCLPDB1 (driver chosen when omitted).

url_env.description: Environment variable that holds the URL (with its password), used instead of `url`: keeps the password out of the file. Specs written for sharing (introspect drafts, exported spec.yaml, bundles) show the URL with *** for the password and set url_env (RELSYNTH_SOURCE_URL).

password_env.description: Environment variable that holds only the password; the URL then carries user, host and database.

schema.description: Database schema to read or write (Oracle: the owning user).

null_values.description: CSV fields read as null. Only an empty field by default, so 'NA' (Namibia), 'None' and 'null' stay values; e.g. ['', 'NULL', 'n/a'].

connect_args.description: Driver connection arguments (TLS settings, timeouts), passed to the driver as they are.

auth.description: Cloud warehouses: how to sign in, without secrets in the file. `method` (databricks: token, oauth-m2m, azure-sp, oauth-u2m, azure-u2m, default; fabric: default, azure-sp, azure-cli, managed-identity, interactive, sql-login; snowflake: key-pair, pat, oauth, password, sso, workload-identity, default; bigquery: default, service-account, external-account, impersonate) and the environment variables that hold the secrets as <name>_env (token_env, client_id_env, client_secret_env, tenant_id_env, password_env, private_key_passphrase_env) or key files as <name>_file. Without it: databricks uses DATABRICKS_TOKEN when set, else the platform's credential chain; fabric uses the Azure credential chain; snowflake uses the URL's password; bigquery uses Application Default Credentials.

guards.description: Cloud warehouses: cost guards. query_tag (default relsynth: marks every query in the warehouse's history), max_rows (largest table read into memory), max_bytes (largest estimated scan of one statement, e.g. 100GB). `relsynth plan` reports the bytes each table costs.

bulk.description: Cloud warehouse targets: the load path. databricks: {method: insert} (multi-row INSERT, the default), {method: volume, volume: /Volumes/cat/schema/vol} (Parquet staged in a Unity Catalog volume, then COPY INTO) or {method: path, path: <location the warehouse reads>}. fabric: {method: insert} (ODBC parameter arrays, the default) or {method: copy, stage: https://<account>.dfs.core.windows.net/<container>/<dir>} (Parquet staged in ADLS Gen2 or OneLake, then COPY INTO). snowflake: {method: insert} (multi-row INSERT, the default) or {method: stage} (Parquet PUT in a temporary stage, then COPY INTO). bigquery: {method: load} (load jobs from Parquet, the default) or {method: insert} (DML INSERT).

format.description: File format written (target of kind files).

engine.description: Folders: what computes the statistics and samples of pushed-down facts. duckdb runs SQL over the files without loading them; pandas reads the needed columns into memory (the 1.0 path); auto is duckdb when it is installed.

duckdb.description: Folders, engine duckdb: memory_limit (e.g. '4GB'), threads, temp_directory (where larger-than-memory sorts and groupings spill).

source.description: Where the real data is read from (the 1.0 `source` section).

kind.description: As for source; csv and parquet write one file per table.

path.description: Output folder or SQLite file; dataset i > 1 goes to <path>_i.

url_env.description: As for source (RELSYNTH_TARGET_URL in shared specs).

schema.description: Target schema (created when missing on PostgreSQL and SQL Server); dataset i > 1 goes to <schema>_i.

if_exists.description: replace: drop and create the tables; append: insert into existing tables; truncate: delete the rows of the existing tables (children first) and insert, keeping the target's DDL and constraints; fail: stop when a table exists.

structure.description: How target tables are created. clone: the source's DDL (column types, nullability, primary, unique and foreign keys, indexes, identity columns) when source and target are databases; infer: from the specification (keys and links as constraints) and the data's types; existing: tables created beforehand. auto: clone when possible, else infer.

format.description: File format of a files target.

target.description: Where the synthetic data is written (the 1.0 `target` section).

containers.description: Physical stores shared by several entities.

entities.description: Entities in order (order is kept: it breaks ties in generation order).

review.description: What introspect inferred, and its questions.

Container.description: A physical store shared by one or more entities (a DynamoDB table, a MongoDB collection with several document types, a Kafka topic).

kind.description: table, view, collection, key_value_table, topic, iceberg_table, delta_table, file_set, graph or index.

system.description: System (postgresql, mongodb, dynamodb, kafka, neo4j, iceberg).

partition_key.description: Partition (hash) key attribute of the stored items.

ContainerIndex.description: A secondary index of a container (a DynamoDB GSI, a MongoDB index).

projection.description: Projected attributes: all, keys_only or include.

Entity.description: A set of records of one type: a table, a document collection (or one document type in it), a graph node label or edge type, or an event stream.

shape.description: record (flat row), document (nested), node, edge or event.

role.description: entity (a thing), fact (an event or link whose records exist because of its parents) or view (the join of others, rebuilt).

keys.description: Primary, unique and filtered unique keys.

dependencies.description: Functional dependencies (implied levels, link determines link).

variants.description: Polymorphic records: attributes that depend on a discriminator.

view.description: For role view: its base entity.

time.description: Event time, valid time and versioning.

allocation.description: Weights summing to a total per group (bridge).

stream.description: For shape event: stream keys and ordering.

Attribute.description: A column, a document field, a node or edge property, or an event field.

type.description: Logical data type: string, integer, number, boolean, date, timestamp, time, binary, object (with fields), array (with items), map.

kind.description: How relsynth models the value (the 1.0 column types): id, integer, float, categorical, boolean, date, datetime, text, pii, constant, lookup, binary, sequence.

optional.description: May be absent from a record or document (distinct from null).

physical_type.description: Type in the source system (VARCHAR(20), NUMBER(10,2), ObjectId).

physical_name.description: Name in the source system when it differs.

virtual.description: Not stored: the identity of a graph edge's endpoint, or a value computed on load.

lookup.description: Value of a parent's attribute through foreign keys ('fk.col', 'fk.fk2.col'), or a keyed lookup into a reference entity.

map.description: Lookup values mapped through a fixed table (country -> currency).

sequence.description: For kind sequence: numbered within another attribute.

base_column.description: For views: the base entity's attribute this one copies.

fields.description: For type object: the nested attributes, in order.

length.description: For type array: number of elements {min, max} (multiplicity).

KeyedLookup.description: A value read from a reference table by matching expressions of this row.

table.description: Reference entity (mode copy, no primary key).

match.description: Reference attribute -> expression of this row (OrderDate, 'USD', CurrencyCode).

Sequence.description: Numbers 1..n (or start..) within each value of another attribute.

within.description: Attribute that groups the rows (the order number).

Variants.description: Polymorphic content: which further attributes a record or object has depends on the value of a discriminator (a tagged union).

discriminator.description: Attribute whose value names the variant (`type`, `kind`).

cases.description: Discriminator value -> the attributes that variant adds.

open.description: Values not listed may occur (their extra attributes are not described).

AttributePrivacy.description: What an attribute reveals about the privacy unit.

role.description: direct_identifier (names the person: e-mail, account number), quasi_identifier (identifies in combination: birth date, postcode), sensitive (a value to protect: diagnosis, salary), non_sensitive.

classification.description: The organisation's classification label (public, internal, confidential, restricted).

AttributeSynthesis.description: How relsynth's engine produces the values (1.0 column options).

kind.description: The stated law (drawn independently of the other columns).

min.description: uniform: lower end; others: clip below.

max.description: uniform: upper end; others: clip above.

mean.description: normal, poisson; lognormal: mean of the log.

sd.description: normal; lognormal: sd of the log.

start.description: date_range: first date; sequence: first value.

distribution.description: Draw from a stated law instead of the learned one (1.0 `distribution`).

condition_on.description: Column the text depends on (category of a product title).

min_token_rows.description: A token must appear in at least this many rows.

max_copy_ngram.description: No rare source n-gram of this length is copied.

whole_values.description: Generate whole labels seen in the source (nested labels).

pattern.description: Shape for the pattern generator (learned when absent).

pii.description: Options of a pii attribute (1.0 `pii`: generator, pattern).

offset_from.description: This date/number = that attribute + a modelled gap.

ratio_of.description: This number = that number x a modelled factor (attribute or fk.col path).

ratio_same_as.description: Use the factor of another ratio attribute.

Key.description: A key: attributes no two records share.

attributes.description: Key attributes, in order (several for a composite key).

kind.description: surrogate (generated, no business meaning) or natural (a business identifier).

where.description: Rows the key applies to (a filtered unique index), as a rule expression.

Dependency.description: A functional dependency inside an entity: the determinant's value fixes the dependents' values (GeoAreaKey -> State, Country; a track's album fixes its genre: a link that determines another link).

determinant.description: The determining attribute (a code or a foreign key).

anchor.description: A coarse dependent kept as a modelled attribute (Country), or the determinant itself for a link that determines other links.

View.description: An entity that is the join of others, rebuilt from them.

of.description: The base entity the view's rows come from.

Time.description: The time semantics of an entity's records.

event_time.description: When the event happened (a sale's date, an event's timestamp).

ingestion_time.description: When the record reached the store (processing time of a stream).

ValidTime.description: The period during which a record is true in the world (SQL:2011 application time).

to.description: End attribute (null on the open, current version).

Versioning.description: Records are versions of a natural key (type 2 slowly changing dimension).

natural_key.description: The business key shared by the versions.

scd_type.description: Slowly-changing-dimension type as written in a 1.0 spec (2).

stable.description: auto, or the attributes repeated across versions.

PartitionField.description: A partition of the physical layout: a transform of a source attribute (Iceberg hidden partitioning; identity = Hive-style partition column).

transform.description: identity, year, month, day, hour, bucket, truncate or void.

param.description: bucket: number of buckets; truncate: width.

SortField.description: One field of a sort order: a source attribute, a transform, a direction and null placement.

Discriminator.description: How the records of this entity are told apart in a container shared by several entities.

Physical.description: Where and how an entity is stored.

container.description: Name of a container in `containers` (shared tables, topics, collections).

format.description: Storage format: parquet, orc, avro, csv, json, bson, delta, iceberg.

sort_order.description: Sort order within files or partitions.

clustering.description: Clustering columns (Delta liquid clustering, Snowflake clustering keys).

discriminator.description: Type attribute in a shared container (single-table design).

key_templates.description: Container key attribute -> template built from this entity's attributes ('CUSTOMER#{customer_id}').

Edge.description: A graph edge type: each record joins a source node to a target node.

source.description: Relationship (from this entity) to the source node.

target.description: Relationship (from this entity) to the target node.

multiple.description: Several edges may join the same two nodes.

loops.description: An edge may join a node to itself.

Stream.description: An event stream (a topic or log): records arrive over time per key.

order_by.description: Attribute that orders the events of one key (event time or a sequence number).

partitions.description: Number of partitions of the topic.

max_lateness.description: Bound on event-time disorder (ISO 8601 duration, PT5M): the watermark lag.

Allocation.description: Weights that sum to a total over the records of a group (a bridge table).

group.description: Attribute whose records share the weights (customer).

total.description: What the weights of a group sum to (1.0 default 1).

decimals.description: Stored precision; the rounding remainder goes to the largest weight.

public.description: Holds no data about the privacy unit and may be released as it is (code lists, calendars, a product catalogue).

EntitySynthesis.description: relsynth engine options of an entity (1.0 table options).

key_order.description: Keys numbered in the order of this attribute.

group_effects.description: Attributes shared by the records of a group.

link_affinity.description: Links that point at matching parents more often than chance.

unknown_members.description: Key values of records that stand for 'no member' (-1 'Unknown').

generator.description: Generator of the attributes; absent means the estate's synthesis.generator (copula by default).

GeneratorChoice.description: The generator plug-in that models an entity's attributes (relsynth.generators).

name.description: Registered generator name (`relsynth generators list`): copula, independent, cart or a plug-in's.

version.description: Version specifier the plug-in's model version must satisfy, e.g. '>=1.0,<2'.

options.description: Options passed unchanged to the generator.

FactModel.description: How fact records are generated (1.0 `fact`, without time_column, which is time.event_time).

anchor.description: Parent whose records generate the facts: an entity, a relationship name or a foreign-key attribute.

partner.description: Second dimension of the block model (same forms as anchor).

multiplicity.description: auto, none, partner, anchor or block.

time_bucket.description: Bucket of the seasonal profile of event_time.

condition_on_parents.description: Condition measures on parents' continuous attributes.

header.description: Order header carried on the lines.

Header.description: A document header in a fact: the document number, what it determines, and the line number.

line_number.description: Line number attribute, generated 1..n per document.

GroupEffect.description: An attribute whose value is shared by the records of a group.

attribute.description: Attribute shared by the records of a group.

by.description: Attributes or fk.col paths that define a group.

LinkAffinity.description: Two link paths whose values match more often than chance.

match.description: Two paths whose values match more often than chance.

Relationship.description: A reference between entities: a foreign key (composite allowed), a hierarchy inside one entity, a one-to-one extension, or a many-to-many link through a bridge.

name.description: Unique name, used by rules, fact anchors and edges.

from.description: Referencing side (the child: holds the foreign key).

to.description: Referenced side (the parent); attributes default to its primary key.

kind.description: reference (between entities), hierarchy (parent-child inside one entity) or derived (internal: offset keys).

cardinality.description: many_to_one, one_to_one (the referencing attributes are a key) or many_to_many (through `via`).

optional.description: A record may have no parent (null reference); learned when absent.

offset.description: Gap-modelled second reference into an ordered parent.

End.description: One end of a relationship: an entity and its attributes.

attributes.description: Attributes (several for a composite key; fk.col paths allowed on the referencing side).

Offset.description: A second reference into the same ordered parent whose gap is modelled (ship date from order date).

from.description: The base reference attribute of the same entity.

order_by.description: Parent attribute that orders it (the calendar's date).

Via.description: For many_to_many: the bridge entity and its two references.

from.description: Relationship from the bridge to the `from` entity.

to.description: Relationship from the bridge to the `to` entity.

Rule.description: A business rule. Hard rules (holds 1) hold on every record; soft rules on a share.

type.description: check (must hold), derive (attribute = expression), aggregate (parent attribute from its children) or cumulative (running balance).

holds.description: derive: share of records on which it holds (below 1: a soft rule).

via.description: aggregate: relationship name when there are several.

opening.description: cumulative: first value of each group.

EstatePrivacy.description: Privacy settings of the estate: the unit, the adjacency and the paths not followed.

adjacency.description: add_remove (a unit and all its data present or absent) or replace.

exclude_paths.description: Relationships not followed when tracing contributions (a shared lookup).

PrivacyUnit.description: Whose privacy is protected: neighbouring datasets differ in all the data of one unit (Ponomareva et al. 2026).

entity.description: Entity whose records are the units (Customer).

description.description: Free text (a customer and everything they bought).
